guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the VOICE Social Camp
guide.description: Go to the VOICE Social Camp page. This is the pre-launch hub where quests, leaderboards, and CLOUT tracking live.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Sign in with your X account
guide.description: Connect your X account, since most quests track posts, quotes, and mentions there. You can also continue with a Google account or a Solana wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete Core, Daily, and Burst tasks
guide.description: Clear the Core tasks first, then return for the Daily set. Burst tasks are shorter, higher-value entries announced in the VOICE Discord , so keep an eye there for drops.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Vote in polls and Opinion Cup battles
guide.description: Cast votes on active polls and in Opinion Cup matchups. Each vote earns CLOUT, and the Cup runs creator battles with USDT prize pools on top.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Join the Voice Pulse campaign
guide.description: Enter the Voice Pulse campaign for extra CLOUT and rewards. This round closes on September 1, so finish its tasks before the deadline.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Layer3 VOICE campaign
guide.description: Head to the separate VOICE campaign on Layer3 , which carries an advertised $2,000 reward pool. Complete the listed quests to qualify for a share.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Enter partner clusters
guide.description: Join the partner clusters inside Social Camp. These bundle quests from partner projects and carry their own USDT and NFT pools alongside CLOUT.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite friends through FRENS
guide.description: Share your FRENS invite link. You earn a permanent 10% boost on the CLOUT your invitees generate, so early invites keep paying through the rest of the campaign.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Apply for the Ambassador Program
guide.description: Open the VOICE Ambassador application and enter your region, X, Discord, and Telegram handles, average views, and posts per day Pick your content themes and answer the quick checks, including whether you’ve joined the VOICE Discord and the VOICE social campaign Explain why you want to join and submit Applicants need organic engagement and must post in English at least 80% of the time. A blue check
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
